title: Encode an ammo update after a rifle burst
setup: Create a level and player scene, then run the script on a plain Node. It logs the remaining rounds and the four-byte payload after the update round-trips. [Ammo update setup](/binary-messages#encode-an-ammo-update)

title: Read a fixed-size practice target measurement
setup: Attach the script to a plain Node and run the scene. Output shows the decoded target ID and distance from the six-byte reading. [Practice target setup](/binary-messages#read-and-write-fields-directly)
